name: Rex Sealing and Packing Indust
summary: Based in Mumbai, India, Rex Sealing & Packing Industries Ltd. was founded in 1963 by Manjunath Nayak. The company specializes in manufacturing and internationally distributing a variety of sealing, packing, and insulation materials. Its product portfolio includes jointing sheets, fabric expansion joints, gland packing and ropes, as well as textiles designed to resist high temperatures.
